description: Ejes de calles is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Rocha. Shapefile con los ejes de calle de las localidades del departamento de Rocha. Contiene los ejes con los nombres de calles oficiales aprobados por la Junta Departamental de Rocha para aquellos casos en los que existe resolución al respecto. Coverage: Intendencia de Rocha. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Rocha. Its tags are Calles, Geográficos. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
